stance: Inflation pipeline is heating and now shows in PCE. September core PCE rose 0.32% m/m (3.12% y/y, from 3.03%), headline 0.49% m/m (3.65% y/y). This follows September PPI of 1.3% m/m headline and 0.7% core. Core PCE is 1.1pp above the 2% target and y/y is still accelerating, so cuts stay pushed back. Softer view needs energy reversal and core m/m near 0.2% to 0.3%.
